method: Largest saturated turquoise component in native pixels y=138..165 gives pearl center; brightness-weighted near-neutral ink centroid in y=92..132 gives visible text ink center. Bead layout regression independently checks the caption advance-box center within 1 physical pixel.
interpretation: Bead pearls follow each caption's advance-box center. Positive offsets put the pearl right of the brightness-weighted visible ink centroid; asymmetric glyph ink leaves Weather at +2.10 px while the caption-box regression stays within 1 physical pixel. QML centers the icon-plus-caption group; this difference follows B0111's explicit text placement request.
